---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Garrett Grolemund <grol...@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, Sep 1, 2010 at 5:39 PM
Subject: ggplot2 case study competiton and wiki
To: ggp...@googlegroups.com, r-h...@r-project.org

Hi all,

We've moved the ggplot2 wiki to a new location to make it more useful,
http://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki.  To publicize the new location,
we’re organizing a second ggplot2 case study competition. Some great
prizes are at stake:

* grand prize will be a 32GB ipod touch generously donated by
Revolution Analytics.

* two runner ups will receive a free Use R! book of their choice
generously donated by Springer.

To enter, write up a small case study where you’ve found ggplot2
useful and add it to the wiki home page. The deadline for entry is
October 1, 2010. See
http://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/Case-study-competition for more
details, as well as for example submissions from last year's
competition.

Good luck,

Garrett and Hadley

--

messages.subject_clean: Survey participants for a dissertation research ($5 incentive offered)
messages.body_plain:
Če želiš "zaslužiti" $5 s testiranjem web-based programske opreme za prostorsko analizo - beri dalje.

lp,
Roman

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Myunghwa Hwang <mhw...@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, Sep 1, 2010 at 11:05 PM
Subject: [R-sig-Geo] Survey participants for a dissertation research ($5 incentive offered)
To: r-si...@stat.math.ethz.ch

Hello, all!

First of all, I am sorry for cross-posting.

I am writing this email to ask your help with my dissertation research.
I am currently conducting an online survey on usability of a web-based spatial analysis tool.
In this survey you will test an online tool for spatial cluster analysis
and evaluate its properties from a user perspective.
To appreciate your help, we offer you $5 Amazon Gift Certificate when you complete the survey.

For more information, please read the section below.
Before beginning the survey, please watch this linked video:
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wb-qmd1iDTI
After watching the video, you can visit the following website to participate in the survey:
http://ec2-184-72-164-144.compute-1.amazonaws.com/web_sa3/

I really appreciate all your help!
Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have any questions.

Sincerely,

Myunghwa Hwang

====================================================================

Looking for Usability Evaluation Participants

An exciting opportunity awaits you!
Myunghwa Hwang and Elizabeth Wentz in School of Geographical Sciences and Urban Planning at Arizona State University (ASU) are looking for people to help evaluate and review a we-based software program for local cluster analysis. As a participant in this software evaluation, you will be given a $5 Amazon Gift Certificate
as well as have an opportunity to influence the direction, appearance, and “look and feel” of web-based spatial analysis software programs.

We are looking for potential candidates that represent general users of spatial analysis software programs.
Anyone who is over 18 years old and has the following characteristics can help our usability evaluation:
Casual computer users
Some experiences with statistical tools (e.g., SPSS, SAS, GeoDa), GIS packages (e.g., ArcGIS, MapInfo, QGIS), or other online geospatial tools (e.g., Google Earth, Google or Yahoo Map)
Some knowledge of spatial analysis techniques (e.g., exploratory data analysis, spatial autocorrelation analysis, spatial regression)
No involvement with any previous versions of this survey
In other words, we are looking for people who are interested in using software programs to visualize and analyze map data. Will you help us?

If you would like to participate in our usability evaluation,
please check out this tutorial video stream <http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Wb-qmd1iDTI> first and visit our online survey site at the following location:
http://ec2-184-72-164-144.compute-1.amazonaws.com/web_sa3/

The software evaluation generally takes no more than 15 minutes, and our survey system will guide you step-by-step.
If you are interested in participating in our evaluation and have any other questions, please send an email to us (mhw...@gmail.com or mhw...@asu.edu).

We hope that you will take an active role in enhancing usability of spatial analytical software programs.
Your participation is greatly appreciated.

--
Myunghwa Hwang
GeoDa Center
School of Geographical Sciences and Urban Planning
Arizona State University
mhw...@gmail.com or Myunghw...@asu.edu

_______________________________________________

R-si...@stat.math.ethz.ch
https://stat.ethz.ch/mailman/listinfo/r-sig-geo

--

messages.body_plain:
Jaz bi apply familijo združil s kakim srečanjem, kjer bi se učili koristnost in pisanje custom funkcij, ki so tovorna mula R-a. Uvodoma bi kajpak spisali kako svojo funkcijo, ki jo lahko nato pošljemo tudi v apply.
Če plyerju ne želimo storiti krivice, bo pa verjetno terjal kar svojo posebno srečanje.

Je pa pred časom tekla debata, da bi na kakem srečanju poizkusili analizirati konkretne podatke. Če ima kdo kake podatke, ki bi jih analiziral v R-u pa ne ve točno kako pristopiti k zadevi, lahko to storimo kar skupaj na enem od srečanj. Če bi bil kdo potencialni "darovalec" takih podatkov lahko kontaktira Maartena, Tomaža S. ali mene, po mailu, telefonu ali osebno.

Kolikor poznam situacijo bi bilo najbolj ugodno, da začnemo s srečanji z oktobrom, neformalno pa lahko tudi že prej. Meni bi najbolj odgovarjalo po 24., ker bom prej bolj ali manj zasut z delom oz. na Medvedjaku.

Za prvo srečanje še nimamo definitivne teme, v igri je še kar nekaj možnosti. Če ima kdo kako idejo kaj bi rad slišal pa kar na dan z besedo.

lp,
Roman

Prvo tema lahko doloďż˝imo na predprvem neformalnem sestanku. Ob pijaďż˝i
bomo lahko bolj sprostili svoje zavoRe, ane, pa tudi laďż˝je se bo kdo
javil, ki bi pripravil kak tutorial za prihodnje sreďż˝anje. Ni treba, da
smo super uďż˝inkoviti ďż˝e na prvi uri, tudi v prihodnje bo po mojem
posameznikom laďż˝je prispevati k druďż˝benemu naporu, ďż˝e se bo v tej druďż˝bi
dobro in domaďż˝e poďż˝util. Jaz, recimo, sem malo ven padel iz R-anja in
sem vďż˝eraj rabil 40 minut, da sem na histogram dal puďż˝ďż˝ice z napakami...
tako da bi mi prijal bolj sproďż˝ďż˝en zaďż˝etek. Mislim, da bi se nam taka
ura obrestovala, da bodo potem lahko na nasledni UseR konferenci lahko
spet govorili o nas. :)
LP
 Luka

messages.subject: ggplot - problemčič
messages.body_plain:
Pozdravljeni!

Se je morda ďż˝e kdo sreďż˝al s takim problemom v ggplot2:

(Podatki, koda in graf so v priponki.)

Podatki: dataframe z dvema spremenljivkama ('tgroup', 'sub.f'), obe sta
faktorski

Nariďż˝em barplot:
na x osi je 'tgroup' (Taksonomsko-razvojna skupina),
y os je prirejena - namesto frekvenc so procenti, ampak to niti ni vaďż˝no
- problem, ki ga bom opisala, ni odvisen od tega.

Podatke grupiram glede na vrednost 'sub.f' (dva nivoja: 'razpoloďż˝ljivo'
in 'uplenjeno'), uporabim ukaza 'group' in 'position="dodge".

In tu se pojavi problemďż˝ek, ki ga ne znam reďż˝it.
ďż˝e pri kakďż˝ni vrednosti x ('tgroup') v dataframu ni nobenega podatka za
enega od nivojev 'sub.f' (kar v bistvu pomeni, da je frekvenca enaka 0),
potem se pri tej vrednosti x na grafu izriďż˝e stolpec samo za drugi nivo
'sub.f' (kjer frekvenca ni enaka 0). Kar je seveda normalno. Tisto, kar
mene moti je pa to,
da stolpec zavzame po ďż˝irini celotno polje, namesto da bi ga samo
polovico, druga polovica polja pa bi bila prazna.

Konkreten primerďż˝iďż˝:
Na grafu pri vrednosti 4 je ďż˝irok zelen stolpiďż˝, ki prikazuje % uplenjenih.
% oz. frekvenca razpoloďż˝ljivih je bil v tem primeru enak 0.
Jaz bi ďż˝elela, da zelen stolpiďż˝ zavzema samo svojo polovico polja, druga
polovica, ki naďż˝eloma pripada rjavim stolpiďż˝em, pa naj bi bila v tem
primeru prazna.

Ima kdo kakďż˝no idejo?
Bi bila hvaleďż˝na!

Upam, da sem OK opisala. ďż˝e kaj ni jasno, pa zastavite dodatna vpraďż˝anja.

Lp, Urďż˝a

P.S. Glede nekaterih navideznih vsebinskih nelogiďż˝nosti (npr.
razpoloďż˝ljivo = 0, uplenjeno > 0) se ne sekirajte. Obstaja razlaga :-)
